home.js.why: The home page's JavaScript, gzip: the showcase must stay fast. main before the showcase measured 238.7. Raised with the Kirana site's header and footer (the footer's landscape loads its drawing on demand) (Base UI's NavigationMenu and the mega menu, about 13 KB on every page; its panels load on demand). Then to 295 KB with the four project pages: the router's route tree, which every page loads, grows with each page the site adds. Then to 302 KB with the showcase's framework switch (Base UI's Tabs, about 6 KB; the other frameworks' showcases load in their frame, not in this page). Then for the typeset builder (P3-13): its two routes in the route tree every page loads, and the header's Typeset link, about 2.4 KB; main measured 302.5 before it, already over by the per-framework docs' page manifest (#46). Then for P2-06's first group (Textarea, Checkbox, Radio Group, Switch, Table): about 2.8 KB, most of it the docs manifest every page loads (each variant page with its siblings, and a lazy import per page) and Base UI's shared chunks; main measured 305.5 before it. Then for P2-06's second group (Kbd, Spinner, Toggle, Toggle Group, Native Select, Slider, Input Group, Input OTP): the icon map every placeholder reads, which holds every icon the registry names (about 6 KB), the docs manifest's new pages, and Base UI's parts the new components share with the site's chrome; main measured 309.1 before it. Then for P2-06's third group (Badge, Alert, Aspect Ratio, Empty, Item, Progress, Marker, Button Group, Scroll Area), about 11 KB: the icon map every placeholder reads, now with the new demos' icons (5.3 KB), the React preview map every framed page reads, an entry per demo (6.1 KB), and the docs search index (4.2 KB); main measured 316.6 before it.

home.css.why: The stylesheets the home page loads, gzip: Kirana's compiled stylesheet and the registry's reset and fonts. Then to 52 KB for the fonts (CLI-11): every family of the font axes now has its token entries on `<html>` (the body's and the heading's, about 1 KB), where only Inter and Geist had. Then to 55 KB for P2-06's first group: Kirana compiles the site, its preview pages included, into one stylesheet every page links, so each ported component's CSS reaches the home page too (3.0 KB for five components; KF-052 asks for a stylesheet per route). Then to 63 KB for P2-06's second group: 7 KB of its eight components' CSS in the one stylesheet every page links (KF-052); main measured 53.6 before it. Then to 67 KB for P2-06's third group: 4.6 KB of its nine components' CSS in the one stylesheet every page links (KF-052); main measured 60.5 before it.
